cases.expected: empty Set (validation succeeds because exactly one subschema matches)
cases.description: The instance matches only the first subschema (e.g., schema requiring property "type" = "A"). The validator should return an empty set of ValidationMessage, indicating success.

cases.description: The instance does not satisfy any of the defined subschemas. The validator must report a oneOf validation error.

cases.expected: Set containing a ValidationMessage with code "oneOf" and message indicating multiple subschemas match
cases.description: The instance satisfies more than one subschema (e.g., both a schema that requires "type":"A" and another that allows any object with an "extra" field). The validator must report a oneOf validation error because more than one schema matches.

cases.expected: empty Set (validation succeeds because a missing node is considered valid for oneOf)

cases.expected: empty Set (validation succeeds and validator short‑circuits after first matching subschema)

cases.expected: empty Set (validation succeeds after checking all subschemas)
cases.description: The validator’s `canShortCircuit()` returns false. Even though the first subschema matches, the validator continues to evaluate all subschemas before returning success.

cases.expected: Set containing a ValidationMessage with code "oneOf" indicating that no subschema matches
cases.description: The instance is an array, while all subschemas expect an object. The validator must report a oneOf error because none of the subschemas validate the array.

cases.expected: Set containing a ValidationMessage with code "oneOf" indicating that no subschema matches
cases.description: An empty object does not satisfy any of the defined subschemas (e.g., each subschema requires a specific property). Validation should fail with a oneOf error.

cases.description: The instance matches the subschema that requires "type":"A". Another subschema in the oneOf list only matches objects that contain an "extra" field, which this instance lacks, so only one subschema matches and validation succeeds.

cases.expected: empty Set (validation succeeds because exactly one subschema matches the nested object)
